entries.text: Patch Changes #18622 1dab71a Thanks @Toyenzo! - Fixes i18n locale matching for pages whose first path segment is named like an Object.prototype property, such as /constructor/ or /toString/. These were treated as locales, producing invalid alternate links. Also rejects an i18n defaultLocale that is only an inherited object property rather than a configured locale.
